description: parseCron(expr, tz) and nextCronRun(spec, afterMs). `output` is {spec} — the CronSpec: sorted ascending value arrays, domRestricted/dowRestricted, tz (absent in JSON when no zone was given) — plus `nextMs` when `input.afterMs` is present: the first matching instant strictly after it as epoch milliseconds, or null when the expression never matches within the 1464-day search bound. A parse failure is {error: {kind, message}}. `input.after` is `afterMs` as ISO 8601, for reading. A skipped wall-clock time (spring forward) has no occurrence; an ambiguous one (fall back) resolves to the earlier instant.
